newsitem.title: USA: Loehmann's sees Q4 EPS $0.14, sales up.
newsitem.headline: Loehmann's sees Q4 EPS $0.14, sales up.

text.p: Loehmann's Inc said Wednesday it expects to report 1996 fourth earnings of $1.3 million, or $0.14 per share, compared to a net loss of $500,000, or $0.05 per share, on a pro forma basis, a year earlier.
The company said sales for the quarter, ended February 1, were $108.6 million, up from $95.8 million in the comparable 13 weeks in the fourth quarter of 1995.
Comparable-store sales for the quarter declined about 5.4 percent, it said.

For sales comparisons, the company adjusted its sales reporting period for the fourth quarter of fiscal 1995 from the 14 weeks ended February 2, 1996, to the 13 weeks ended January 27, 1996. There was no adjustment for earnings comparisons.
According to Loehmann's, fourth quarter comparable-store sales results were hurt by a shortge of inventory.
The company said sales in its three new stores opened during October and November were stronger than anticipated, leading to a shortage of inventory amid heavy store traffic.
Loehmann's said sales were also affected by earlier promotional selling in department stores during December due to the shorter holiday selling period.
